newsitem.title: USA: Delia's IPO priced at $11 per share.
newsitem.headline: Delia's IPO priced at $11 per share.

text.p: Delia's Inc on Wednesday said its initial public offering of 2.4 million shares of its common stock was priced at $11 per share.
The company said it sold 2.0 million shares and certain selling stockholders sold 350,000 shares.
The stock will begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the symbol "DLIA."
Hambrecht & Quist LLC lead-managed the underwriting group and Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. served as co-manager.
The IPO's estimated price range was $10 to $12.
The company is a direct marketer of casual apparel and related accessories to girls and young women between the ages 10 through 24.
